files.role: Pure spaced-repetition scheduling logic — independently unit-testable, no DB or HTTP dependency. Unchanged this sprint.

public_objects.name: VALID_GRADES
public_objects.purpose: frozenset/tuple of the four accepted grade values: again, hard, good, easy

methods.name: compute_next_due_at
methods.purpose: Implements the exact scheduling formula from 10_architecture.json contracts.invariants: again -> now + 5s flat; hard/good/easy -> now + max(floor, 2*elapsed) where elapsed is null-safe against a never-reviewed card, using the fixed floors 1 minute / 20 minutes / 1 day

files.role: One-shot markdown ingestion (CLI entrypoint plus a directly-callable function for tests) PLUS the shared upsert core used by both the markdown CLI path and the new JSON API path. Implements the markdown grammar from 10_architecture.json internal_flow steps 2 (parsing, unchanged) and the shared transactional upsert from step 3 (extracted this sprint into upsert_document, called from both ingest() and the new POST /essays/ingest handler in routers/essays.py). This must be a pure refactor of step 3 — see 10_architecture.json contracts.invariants for the regression requirement (Sprint01's 36 tests must pass unchanged).

public_objects.name: IngestionError
public_objects.purpose: Raised for any parse/validation failure before a database write is attempted; carries a human-readable message citing the offending line, section, or card. Unchanged this sprint.

methods.name: ingest
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Now a thin wrapper: reads the file at path, parses it via _parse_document (unchanged), then delegates the transactional upsert to upsert_document(conn, doc). Raises IngestionError on any validation failure before touching the database. Callable directly from tests without shelling out. Behavior must be identical to Sprint01 — only the internal call structure changed.

methods.name: upsert_document
methods.purpose: [NEW] The shared upsert core, extracted this sprint from what was previously inline inside ingest(). Given a doc dict shaped {title, slug, sections: [{heading, anchor_slug, order_index, body_markdown, cards: [{card_key, question, answer}]}]}, opens one transaction on conn and upserts the essay (keyed by slug), each section (keyed by essay_id+anchor_slug), and each card (keyed by essay_id+card_key) using the exact SQL already implemented in Sprint01's ingest() (ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE, was_inserted via xmax=0, flashcard_review_state row created only when was_inserted is true). Commits on success; rolls back and re-raises on any database error. Called by ingest() (markdown/CLI path) and by the new POST /essays/ingest handler (JSON/API path) — the single place all essaycards upsert SQL lives; must not be duplicated in routers/essays.py.

public_objects.name: IngestSummary
public_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] Return value of ingest()/upsert_document(): now also carries essay_id (str, the upserted essay's id) in addition to the existing essay_created (bool) and sections_created/sections_updated/flashcards_created/flashcards_updated (int) fields. essay_id is populated by upsert_document from the essay upsert's RETURNING id, so the JSON API response can include it without a second query. Adding this field must not change any existing attribute's meaning or Sprint01 test assertions.

private_objects.name: _parse_front_matter
private_objects.purpose: Extract and yaml.safe_load the leading '---' delimited front matter block; requires non-empty title and slug. Unchanged this sprint.

private_objects.name: _split_sections
private_objects.purpose: Scan body lines for `^##\s+(.+?)\s*\{#([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)\}\s*$`; returns ordered (heading, anchor_slug, content) tuples; raises IngestionError on a `##` line missing the anchor suffix. Unchanged this sprint.

private_objects.name: _split_body_and_cards
private_objects.purpose: Given one section's raw content, locate at most one ```flashcards fenced block; returns (body_markdown, cards_yaml_text); raises IngestionError on multiple fences or trailing content after the fence. Unchanged this sprint.

private_objects.name: _parse_cards_yaml
private_objects.purpose: yaml.safe_load the fenced content, validate top-level `cards` list, validate each entry has non-empty id/q/a. Unchanged this sprint.

private_objects.name: _validate_uniqueness
private_objects.purpose: Raise IngestionError if the same anchor_slug appears twice across sections, or the same card id (card_key) appears twice across the whole file. Unchanged this sprint.

private_objects.name: _upsert_essay
private_objects.purpose: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE; returns essay id. Unchanged this sprint; now called from upsert_document instead of directly from ingest().

private_objects.name: _upsert_section
private_objects.purpose: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (essay_id, anchor_slug) DO UPDATE; returns section id. Unchanged this sprint; now called from upsert_document instead of directly from ingest().

private_objects.name: _upsert_flashcard
private_objects.purpose: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (essay_id, card_key) DO UPDATE ... RETURNING id, created_at, (xmax = 0) AS was_inserted; if was_inserted, also inserts the matching flashcard_review_state row with last_reviewed_at=null, next_due_at=created_at. Unchanged this sprint; now called from upsert_document instead of directly from ingest().

[CHANGED] GET /essays and GET /essays/{essay_id} (unchanged from Sprint01) PLUS the new POST /ingest endpoint. POST /ingest reads the raw Starlette Request body manually (no Pydantic model), structurally validates it (10_architecture.json internal_flow step 8), runs the one DB-dependent collision check when the essay already exists (step 9), then calls backend.ingest.upsert_document(conn, doc) — never duplicates upsert SQL locally. Route handler functions (list_essays, get_essay, ingest_essay) are not individually enumerated below, per this scaffold's existing convention (see flashcards.py) — only the router constant and private helpers are.

private_objects.purpose: Convert a psycopg2 RealDictRow section row to a JSON-serializable dict for embedding under 'sections'. Unchanged this sprint.

private_objects.name: _SLUG_LIKE_RE
private_objects.purpose: [NEW] Compiled regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$ — shared format check for the payload's slug, every section's anchor_slug, and every card's id.

private_objects.name: _validate_ingest_body
private_objects.purpose: [NEW] Given the raw parsed JSON body (Any), performs the full structural validation described in 10_architecture.json internal_flow step 8 and returns (doc, None) on success or (None, JSONResponse) with an ApiError VALIDATION_ERROR on the first violation found. Builds the doc dict ({title, slug, sections: [{heading, anchor_slug, order_index, body_markdown, cards: [{card_key, question, answer}]}]}) with order_index assigned from array position and id/q/a renamed to card_key/question/answer. Never touches the database.

private_objects.name: _check_card_section_collisions
private_objects.purpose: [NEW] Given (cur, existing_essay_id: str, doc: dict), queries existing flashcards for existing_essay_id whose card_key appears in doc's incoming cards, joined to their current section's anchor_slug. Returns a JSONResponse ApiError VALIDATION_ERROR (naming the colliding card_key and both anchor_slugs) if any existing card_key is attached to a different anchor_slug than the one it appears under in doc; returns None if no collision. Must be called, and must return None, before backend.ingest.upsert_document is invoked.
